description: Functional scope: global/non-Person AI runtime reads resolve associated Connect credential and consume ResolvedCredential; translate API-key/OAuth/no-auth only at ProviderSpec/Factory boundary, preserve provider/endpoint metadata and earliest expiry, remove normal legacy api_key/resource-grant fallback. Mock provider HTTP only. Docs: Agent/System config. title: [zaq-jrg.27] Cut over global AI runtime authentication
